methods.name: Landslide identification method that integrates C-index, slope, and ascending/descending orbit deformation information
methods.summary: The method uses DeforNet (a U-shaped encoder-decoder CNN) to identify suspected deformation areas from InSAR data, then filters these areas using the C-index (a projection coefficient relating landslide slope deformation to LOS deformation) and slope thresholds to confirm landslides.
methods.source: Xiong, Z.; Zhang, M.; Ma, J.; Xing, G.; Feng, G.; An, Q. InSAR-based landslide detection method with the assistance of C-index. Landslides 2023, 20, 2709–2723.
methods.verbatim: For a more detailed identification process, refer to [39]. ... Xiong, Z.; Zhang, M.; Ma, J.; Xing, G.; Feng, G.; An, Q. InSAR-based landslide detection method with the assistance of C-index. Landslides 2023, 20, 2709–2723.
